name: Paper Lantern Migration
description: Thousands of origami cranes made from vintage maps and sheet music take flight at twilight, their wings catching the wind like sails, leaving trails of folded light across a lavender sky.
prompt: Massive flock of origami cranes folded from vintage maps and aged sheet music, wings spread catching golden hour light, each crane unique with visible map coordinates and musical notes, trails of folded light particles follow their flight, lavender and peach twilight sky with soft clouds, paper textures crisp and detailed, some cranes glowing from within like lanterns, sense of massive scale and movement, cinematic composition, 8k, ethereal atmosphere
caption:
Carrying stories across the sky, one fold at a time. 🕊️🗺️

Every crease holds a melody. Every flight, a journey home.
